title: From High Energy to Dark Energy: the Creation of DECam
version: 2022-09-12. Firsthand account by the Fermilab DECam project manager in a talk archived by NOIRLab.
lineage: Firsthand account by the Fermilab DECam project manager in a talk archived by NOIRLab.

passages.locator: Slide 12, Key features of early project development
passages.note: Flaugher identifies the prior LBNL CCD designs under development for the SuperNova/Acceleration Probe as usable for DES. Scaling production rate and yield was a principal challenge. Fermilab packaged and tested the CCDs.
